lines.text: Men should regard us as servants of Christ, and stewards must be found faithful.
The Lord judges me, so judge nothing until he comes and exposes the motives of men's hearts.
God displayed the apostles at the end of the procession as fools for Christ while you are wise in Christ.
I write to warn my beloved children, sending Barnabas, my faithful child, to remind you of my way of life.
I will come shortly if the Lord is willing, and shall I come with a sword or in love?
